For I am quite ready to admit, simias and sibs, that I ought to be grieved at death
if I were not persuaded in the first place that I am going to other gods who are wise
and good, of which I am as certain as I can be of any such matters.
And secondly, though I am not so sure of this last, two men departed, better than those
And therefore I do not grieve as I might have done, for I have good hope that there
is yet something remaining for the dead, and as has been said of old, some far better thing
for the good than for the evil.
